items.claim: I could use 4 of 9 parking lots.
items.reason: Parking quality lists 9 total lots and 4 usable ones.

items.claim: On a typical weekday across the usable lots, occupancy was lowest at 3:00 at 25.4% and highest at 12:00 at 43.5%.
items.reason: These typical-day peak and trough hours and values match exactly.

items.claim: Weekend patterns differed by lot.
items.reason: The pooled parking model says weekend effects differed between series.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz was fuller on weekends by 7.8 percentage points.
items.reason: Its weekend effect is a significant +7.8 percentage points.

items.claim: Tiefgarage Friedensplatz and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus were emptier by 13.7 and 15.6 percentage points.
items.reason: Their weekend effects are significant at -13.7 and -15.6 percentage points.

items.claim: Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim showed no measurable weekend change.
items.reason: Its weekend effect is not significant, so no measurable change is supported.

items.claim: Compared with July, only Tiefgarage Hotel Maritim became fuller, by 13.9 percentage points.
items.reason: Hotel Maritim is the only parking lot with a significant positive month-on-month shift, at +13.9 points.

items.claim: The 95% interval was 10.9 to 17.0 percentage points.
items.reason: Hotel Maritim’s 95% confidence interval is 10.9 to 17.0 percentage points.

items.claim: Elbauenpark - Messeparkplatz, Tiefgarage Friedensplatz, and Tiefgarage Ulrichshaus showed no measurable change.
items.reason: All three lots have non-significant adjusted shifts and are listed under no significant change.
